"""联系表单 POM：定位和操作集中，预期由测试定义。"""
from playwright.sync_api import Page


class ContactPage:
    def __init__(self, page: Page):
        self.page = page
        frame = page.frame_locator('iframe[title="联系表单"]')
        self.message = frame.get_by_label("留言")
        self.submit = frame.get_by_role("button", name="提交留言")
        self.status = frame.get_by_role("status")

    def open(self, base_url: str) -> None:
        self.page.goto(base_url + "/iframe")

    def send(self, message: str) -> None:
        self.message.fill(message)
        self.submit.click()

"""录制重构后的用例只保留业务动作和准确断言。"""
from uuid import uuid4

import pytest
from playwright.sync_api import expect

from autotest.web.contact_page import ContactPage

pytestmark = [pytest.mark.web, pytest.mark.demo]


def test_contact_message(page, base_url):
    contact = ContactPage(page)
    contact.open(base_url)
    message = "留言-" + uuid4().hex[:8]
    contact.send(message)
    expect(contact.status).to_have_text("已收到：" + message)
